# About the walkthroughs {.unnumbered}

Every chapter in this book is written to be read straight through. Where a
methodological point is worth understanding but not required to follow the
argument, it lives here instead, and the chapter links to it in one sentence.

Walkthroughs are allowed to be slow, so they can work through a numeric example
step by step, show the intermediate state, and restate a definition that a
chapter would assume. That is their purpose, and it is why the main text does
not have to do it.

Check here first for a term in a chapter that you want
unpacked, and open an issue if it is not covered.
